adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` which does `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The migration creates `embeddable_hosts` without any index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), and applying `lower()` to the column generally prevents use of a normal btree index even if one existed. The diff also routes embed authorization through `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (embed_controller.rb, lib/topic_retriever.rb), meaning this query can run per request. This is a concrete performance/architecture concern introduced by the change, but not a correctness/security defect by itself.
